title: Helsinki Grotesk Pro
slide_intent: Introduce a custom typeface as an identifiable voice so designers can connect technical font choices with a civic identity.
strategic_value: A named custom family can give Helsinki a consistent typographic reference across suppliers.
demonstration: A dark cover splits the large Helsinki Grotesk Pro name across lines beside the Gräbenbach lineage, copyright and Camelot contact information.
practical_value: Identify the family and its publisher before selecting or licensing font files.
